description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Opanayaka, Opanayaka D/S Division, Ratnapura District - (25/0155)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring the determination of title for a specific parcel of land (Parcel No. 1:58 of Block 7) in Ratnapura District. It involves land ownership particulars, cadastral mapping, and formal title settlement by the Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
